;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[2019 Hong Kong protests]]
**Clashes erupt on the campus of [[Hong Kong Polytechnic University]]. Police use [[tear gas]] and [[water cannon]]s. Protesters fire [[Bow and arrow|bows and arrows]] and [[Petrol bomb|petrol bombs]], and [[Arson|set fires]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-hongkong-protests/hong-kong-campus-protesters-fire-bows-and-arrows-set-fires-idUSKBN1XQ0OJ?il=0 (Reuters)]
**[[Pro-democracy]] activist [[Joshua Wong]] urges Germany to stop military assistance to [[China]]. [https://www.outlookindia.com/newsscroll/hong-kong-activist-urges-germany-to-halt-chinese-army-training/1664857 (''Outlook'')]

;Disasters and accidents
*A [[gas explosion]] in [[Chittagong]], [[Bangladesh]], kills at least seven people and injures eight. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-bangladesh-blast/at-least-seven-killed-in-gas-explosion-in-bangladesh-idUSKBN1XR06K (Reuters)]
* The first known case of COVID-19 is traced to a 55-year-old man who had visited a market in Wuhan, Hubei Province, China.

;Health and environment
*[[2019 Samoa measles outbreak]]
**In response to a [[measles]] outbreak, [[Samoa]] declares a [[state of emergency]], closes all schools and urges all persons under 17 to avoid public gatherings. [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2019-11-17/samoa-declares-state-of-emergency-over-measles-outbreak/11711576 (ABC News)]

;International relations
*[[2018–19 Korean peace process]]
**[[United States|U.S.]] [[United States Secretary of Defense|Defense Secretary]] [[Mark Esper]] and [[South Korea]]n [[Ministry of National Defense (South Korea)|Minister of National Defense]] [[Jeong Kyeong-doo]] announce that their countries will postpone their annual joint [[military exercise|military air exercises]] to help facilitate the peace process. [https://www.sfchronicle.com/news/us/article/US-S-Korea-postpone-joint-exercise-criticized-by-14841116.php (''San Francisco Chronicle'')]
*[[Japan–United States relations]], [[Japan–North Korea relations]]
**Japanese [[Defence Minister]] [[Tarō Kōno]] tells his United States and South Korea counterparts that "no one could be optimistic about North Korea" after "they launched over 20 missiles so far this year". [https://news.yahoo.com/japan-tells-u-no-one-070921616.html (Yahoo! News)]

;Law and crime
*[[2019 Fresno shooting]]
**[[mass shooting|At least ten]] people are shot, with four killed, at a backyard party in [[Fresno, California]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2019/11/18/us/fresno-mass-shooting-football-party/index.html (CNN)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2019 Belarusian parliamentary election]]
**Voters in [[Belarus]] head to the polls in the country's latest parliamentary election. The election is closely watched by the [[Organization for Security and Co-operation in Europe]] due to the country's poor [[Human rights in Belarus|human rights record]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/belarus-holds-parliamentary-polls-as-lukashenko-balances-russia-and-the-west/a-51282093 (Deutsche Welle)]
